summary: @servicetitan/uikit-docs preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes a 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13), marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727,680-byte single-line obfuscator.io-style blob (sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc) with `_0x*`-renamed identifiers, a shuffled string/number constant array, and a decoder function. `setup.mjs` itself is also obfuscated. The package is published as a documentation package and has no legitimate build-time need for a second language runtime or an install-time executable payload. `package.json` declares `"files": ["docs"]`, but the tarball also ships `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` at the root, so the install-time executable content sits outside the author-declared shipped surface. On `npm install`, the obfuscated payload runs under the freshly downloaded Bun runtime, executing attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine while evading Node-based static inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
